author: A

components.title: Filter shipped orders
components.what: Select rows where status equals shipped from the CSV.

components.title: Extract units column
components.what: List the units values for each shipped order.

components.title: Sort and compute median
components.what: Sort the units values and compute the median (average of two middle values for even count).

log.author: A
log.draft:
Filtering rows where status = "shipped" gives 10 orders:

ORD-1503: 30, ORD-1071: 15, ORD-1125: 39, ORD-1662: 24, ORD-1542: 31, ORD-1673: 36, ORD-1851: 22, ORD-1687: 20, ORD-1353: 6, ORD-1524: 12

Sorted units: 6, 12, 15, 20, 22, 24, 30, 31, 36, 39

With 10 values (even count), the median is the average of the 5th and 6th values: (22 + 24) / 2 = 23.

FINAL: 23
